title: Report filtering: select a customer and explain every minute
goal: Reconcile a customer-reference filter against own requests while retaining all other records.
prerequisites: 1c-enterprise.a 6; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.
outcomes: Distinguish overall totals, selected sets and equal names.
sections: The starter report offers a Клиент filter; period/status are not ready-made quick settings. Do not search for absent controls. Selecting a reference answers “Alpha requests”; “closed requests this month” requires a different schema/change, handled in the last lesson.

Create own Учебный A7 — Альфа and Учебный A7 — Бета, one service and requests Alpha30/45 and Beta15. Record actual identities. Record overall T0 beforehand: this set adds3 requests/90 minutes. A continuing base has older work, so its full total need not be90. Alpha should yield2/75, Beta1/15.
Filters can act at different levels

Количество counts documents and Минуты sums their ДлительностьМинут, not service cost. Choose by card/code: another equal-named customer without requests yields an empty set. Name text is not a reference. Reconcile source numbers and the selected identity before altering any formula.

Use Настройки, locate Клиент, enable its filter, select the own customer, finish settings and click Сформировать. Disabling the filter restores the overall set without deleting records. An empty selection does not mean the entire base is empty. Regenerate for Alpha, Beta and disabled filtering.
